scope: Six linStat post-1.2.1 commits; five independent assessments; adoption pending

scores.note: Removes the GCC 8 stdc++fs static-link burden. Standalone and stack apply succeed. Real baseline and replacement hwmon paths compile and enumerate 54 keys on this host; sensor values vary. No GCC 8 static-link verification; ReadDir now depends on d_type and explicitly follows symlinks.

Removes the redundant fname member and uses the pinned StatTable::inst member initialized with the same constructor argument. No functional correction demonstrated; performance not measured. Independent clean apply; no post-pin symbol prerequisite.

Adds monitoring rather than correcting a pinned defect. Compiles independently with real pin support sources and installed Base 7.0.10. Actual RTC read succeeds, but malformed date fixture terminates the real RTCTable::update process with SIGSEGV. Requires correction or explicit deferral before carry.

Alignment/layout changes plus three RTC fields. Patch applies alone and XML parses, but those PV records only exist after 6ea15c7. This is a runtime dependency, not an apply/build dependency. No Phoebus rendering performed.

Real CONFIG inclusion probe with INSTALL_LOCATION!=TOP changes missing LINSTAT version/TOP variables to defined values. Existing EPICS-env conf.linStat already explicitly includes CONFIG_LINSTAT_VERSION, limiting immediate benefit. No full module build claimed.

Separates record prefix from interface name. Real msi expansion of legacy IOC,NIC yields byte-identical DB output; P-only invocation expands successfully. commonIocsh keeps the legacy IOC,NIC interface. Phoebus nested-default macro resolution and IOC database loading remain unverified.

Removes the GCC 8 libstdc++fs link workaround and replaces hwmon filesystem traversal. Applies alone and in sequence. Actual lsutils probes preserve directory names and missing-directory exceptions; tblHwmon.cpp compiles. GCC 8 static linking and full hwmon runtime are unverified. Shared ReadDir now follows symlinks for the FD counter too; no measured performance claim.

Removes a redundant filename member and uses the inherited immutable inst string. Actual old/new implementations produced identical 219 values from one captured /proc/net/netstat file and the same handled missing-file outcome. No functional fix demonstrated.

Optional RTC feature, automatically added to host DB. Actual upstream parser has reproduced null loads on failed strptime and a 3600-second false offset for correct local DST time. Valid UTC and actual /proc/driver/rtc worked. Scores reflect value delivered, not a benefit from the defects it introduces.

Display cleanup plus three RTC PV widgets. Applies alone but those widgets require 6ea15c7 records and backend. XML parses; visual rendering and channel connection not verified. Keeping the pin without RTC leaves these new widgets without producers.

Late include restores installed CONFIG_LINSTAT_VERSION visibility when INSTALL_LOCATION differs from TOP. Actual configure-only installs plus CONFIG evaluation show empty version at pin and YES after this patch. Existing EPICS-env conf.linStat already includes the source and installed version files, reducing urgency; no full module build claimed.

Enables an independent NIC record prefix while retaining NIC as the kernel interface selector. Real msi two-stage expansion gives byte-identical legacy IOC,NIC DB and succeeds for P-only prefix with NIC including a colon. Phoebus macro rendering and real IOC load are unverified. Current commonIocsh wrapper still exposes legacy IOC,NIC only.
Removes GCC 8 libstdc++fs linking burden and filesystem use. Independent clean apply and changed-source syntax checks pass; actual static GCC 8 linking and all filesystem error cases were not run.

Removes a duplicate path member; StatTable::inst exists and is const at the pin. Independent clean apply and syntax check pass. No functional defect repair established and no performance measurement performed.

New RTC capability, not a repair to a pinned RTC implementation. Applies alone and actual source probe compiles against the pin, but malformed date/time dereferences null and local RTC during DST reports a false 3600-second delta.

Display feature/alignment update applies independently, but new RTC widgets have a semantic dependency on 6ea15c7. Real MSI record inventory confirms three missing PVs without RTC. Phoebus rendering was not run.

Real CONFIG evaluation at a separate install path restores LINSTAT_TOP/version config discovery. Existing EPICS-env conf.linStat explicitly includes CONFIG_LINSTAT_VERSION already, reducing urgency. Full build not run.

Makes the documented P prefix independent of raw NIC names. Actual MSI generation/expansion verifies all 48 records, exact legacy output equivalence, explicit P without IOC, and P precedence when both supplied. commonIocsh still uses legacy IOC/NIC; Phoebus macro runtime untested.

Removes the GCC 8 stdc++fs link burden without lowering the C++17 requirement. Actual pinned and changed HWMonTable implementations compiled and read live sysfs successfully; live values differed with time, so value equivalence is not claimed. Direct apply and the Makefile overlap sequence passed. GCC 8/static downstream IOC linking remains untested.

Removes a redundant filename copy. Pin already has immutable StatTable::inst. Both actual factories produced byte-identical output from one captured real /proc/net/netstat file and the same open-error outcome. This is maintenance simplification, not a correctness repair.

Adds useful RTC telemetry rather than repairing a pinned defect, but real factory execution segfaulted for invalid time and date filesystem inputs and reported a false 3600-second delta for a correct local-time RTC during DST. Compiled independently at the pin; not dependent on filesystem removal. Low fit reflects these introduced defects.

Alignment and RTC presentation changes apply independently, but the three added RTC PVs require 6ea15c7 or equivalent records. XML parses; actual Phoebus rendering attempts failed before loading because the sandbox could not open DISPLAY. No visual or connected-PV acceptance is claimed.

External INSTALL_LOCATION configuration loading is a valid upstream fix. The actual EPICS-env conf.linStat recipe already includes both source and installed CONFIG_LINSTAT_VERSION. Running that recipe against pristine and patched archives preserved LINSTAT_TOP and LINSTAT_1_2_1; the patch merely added a third version-file include in this measured setup. Low urgency reflects the existing workaround.

Adds a configurable NIC PV prefix while retaining NIC as the interface lookup input. Installed Base 7.0.10 msi on real substitutions/templates produced byte-identical legacy IOC,NIC databases; custom P expanded correctly without IOC. Existing commonIocsh still selects legacy naming. New test source covers the explicit P example but does not itself test legacy fallback. Phoebus runtime macro/render acceptance remains unverified.

Removes the filesystem linker dependency and GCC 8 special handling, but the pin already has a stdc++fs workaround. No target-platform build failure reproduced. No remote or memory-safety fix and no measured speedup. Native ReadDir observes sysfs correctly; shared helper also affects FD scanning. Moderate compatibility value, low urgency, broader than a leaf edit.

Eliminates one duplicate immutable filename string. Both native implementations produce identical values from one captured /proc/net/snmp input. No security, robustness or functional fix, no operational urgency. Tiny allocation saving only, not benchmarked; independent leaf change with very low regression surface.

Adds monitoring rather than correcting existing behavior. RTC battery and clock observations have operational value, but malformed date/time crashes the real parser and local DST time reports a false 3600-second delta. No security, safety, performance or urgency benefit. Clean independent apply and native link, but poor carry fit and host-template exposure.

Alignment/layout adjustment plus three RTC PV widgets. No security, memory-safety, functional bug or performance fix, and no urgency. Operational visibility depends on RTC records from 6ea15c7; pin alone lacks all three. Leaf OPI change, but conditional fit and rendering unverified after DISPLAY failure.

Actual CONFIG evaluation with an external install tree changes missing LINSTAT_1_2_1/LINSTAT_TOP into defined values. A concrete build-configuration correctness fix, narrow and independently applicable. Current EPICS-env conf.linStat recipe already reads the version file, lowering operational urgency. No security, safety or runtime-performance benefit.

Makes the advertised NIC P prefix work: pin P-only expansion fails while patched expansion succeeds; legacy IOC expansion remains byte identical. Actual Phoebus macro expansion matches generated NIC records for legacy, custom and combined inputs. Useful naming flexibility; no remote, memory-safety or performance fix. Modest urgency, strong fit, DB/display/example/test integration surface.

aggregate.subject: Add P macro to linStatNIC and update NIC bob file to use user defined P macro
